strategy.observation: Linear supports workflows shared by humans and AI agents, including building and deploying agents as teammates.
strategy.offer_link: Recruiting and scheduling interviews with customers who work alongside AI agents could help Linear's Head of Product gather evidence about how those shared workflows function in practice, without the product team handling participant coordination.
hypotheses: Linear's product team may want to understand where customers need clearer ownership or handoffs between humans and agents.
Customers with hands-on experience using agents as teammates may be a useful interview segment for upcoming product decisions.
Recruiting and scheduling that segment may consume time the product team would prefer to spend conducting interviews.
strategy.angle: With Linear supporting agents as teammates, would help recruiting and scheduling customer interviews about human–agent handoffs be useful to your product team?
strategy.fit_reason: The offer supports a concrete research use case tied to Linear's human–agent workflows and is relevant to a Head of Product, although the facts do not establish an active research initiative or a participant-recruitment bottleneck.

draft.subject: Customer interviews for agent handoffs
draft.body:
Linear supports workflows shared by people and agents. If your team wants evidence on where those handoffs break down, I can help recruit and schedule customers who work that way.

I handle participant sourcing and coordination for product teams, so they can spend the time on the interviews themselves.

Would a small group of Linear customers using agents as teammates be worth lining up for your next product decision?
